review.reason: The illustration otherwise preserves the mapped course layout, natural single-surface greens, and clearly striped fairways, but the mapped T1 tee is not visible.

issues.detail: T1, shown in the authoritative diagram near the central-left side of the course, is missing from the illustration; only the T2 and T3 tee markers are visible.
issues.consequence: Viewers cannot identify where hole 1 begins, making the overview misleading about its starting point.
